problem.problem:
Anne is big. Anne is blue. Anne is kind. Anne is nice. Charlie is big. Charlie is blue. Charlie is nice. Dave is blue. Dave is cold. Dave is nice. Harry is blue. If Charlie is cold then Charlie is nice. If Harry is kind and Harry is nice then Harry is quiet. All blue things are cold. If something is quiet then it is kind. All kind things are big. Cold things are nice. If Harry is nice and Harry is big then Harry is kind. If something is nice then it is quiet.

Determine whether the following statement is true, false, or unknown:
Charlie is kind.

Big($x, bool) ::: Is x big?
Blue($x, bool) ::: Is x blue?
Kind($x, bool) ::: Is x kind?
Nice($x, bool) ::: Is x nice?
Cold($x, bool) ::: Is x cold?
Quiet($x, bool) ::: Is x quiet?

Facts:
Big(Anne, True) ::: Anne is big.
Blue(Anne, True) ::: Anne is blue.
Kind(Anne, True) ::: Anne is kind.
Nice(Anne, True) ::: Anne is nice.
Big(Charlie, True) ::: Charlie is big.
Blue(Charlie, True) ::: Charlie is blue.
Nice(Charlie, True) ::: Charlie is nice.
Blue(Dave, True) ::: Dave is blue.
Cold(Dave, True) ::: Dave is cold.
Nice(Dave, True) ::: Dave is nice.
Blue(Harry, True) ::: Harry is blue.

Rules:
Cold(Charlie, True) >>> Nice(Charlie, True) ::: If Charlie is cold then Charlie is nice.
Kind(Harry, True) && Nice(Harry, True) >>> Quiet(Harry, True) ::: If Harry is kind and Harry is nice then Harry is quiet.
Blue($x, True) >>> Cold($x, True) ::: All blue things are cold.
Quiet($x, True) >>> Kind($x, True) ::: If something is quiet then it is kind.
Kind($x, True) >>> Big($x, True) ::: All kind things are big.
Cold($x, True) >>> Nice($x, True) ::: Cold things are nice.
Nice(Harry, True) && Big(Harry, True) >>> Kind(Harry, True) ::: If Harry is nice and Harry is big then Harry is kind.
Nice($x, True) >>> Quiet($x, True) ::: If something is nice then it is quiet.

Query:
Kind(Charlie, True) ::: Charlie is kind.
